packagedAppSmoke.pointerMode: isolated Electron pointer events and simulated global coordinates

nativePointerBeforeSizeChange.note: Real Windows pointer mask, gaze, drag and release succeeded before reducing default size; final 112px source and package were checked with isolated Electron input and simulated global coordinates to avoid interfering with the user.

limitations: No Live2D layered source, model or editable motion project yet.
Gaze switches whole existing direction sprites; no independent eye/head parameters.
No audio, complete run-fall/staff/shape-change choreography yet.
Multiple physical monitors, taskbar auto-hide and side taskbars were not all exercised live.

applicationIconUpdate.style: full warm-yellow circular badge with the original Usagi

tailAndDragUpdate.diagnosis: Original left-run fifth frame (row 2, column 4) has a detached 296-pixel alpha>0 outline fragment with a one-pixel transparent gap; both directions have eight frames.
tailAndDragUpdate.correction: Render every left-running frame as a horizontal reflection of the complete right-running frame, including alpha hit detection; original sprite assets unchanged.
tailAndDragUpdate.manualDrag: Horizontal cursor deltas choose left/right run, preserving animation phase when reversing. No horizontal movement for 120 ms returns to idle. Native dragging owns position. Release restores grounded rest and autonomous roaming when enabled.
